title: Do Young Thais Read?
topic: ข่าว/ผลสำรวจ
lines: How much do young Thais read? A national survey of 10,000 students aged
15 to 22 found that they read for an average of 80 minutes a day. That
sounds like a lot, but most of **it** is reading on social media, such as
short posts and comments. Only 25 percent said they had read a whole book
for pleasure in the past month.
The survey also asked students why they did not read more books. The
most common answer was lack of time, followed by the price of books.
**A third** said they found books "boring" compared with videos.
However, the news is not all bad. Sales of e-books and audiobooks among
young people have tripled since 2020, and **many** said they enjoy
listening to stories while traveling. Libraries are also changing. **Some**
now offer free reading apps and comfortable spaces for group study.
Experts say parents and teachers should focus on helping young people
find books **they** enjoy, rather than forcing them to read.
